payload.name: Extract third-party progress praise statements
payload.description: During extraction, when a speaker makes an explicit evaluative statement about another person's progress, achievement, or effort, create a memory candidate preserving the speaker's claim.
content: During extraction, treat a speaker's evaluative statement about a specific other person's progress, achievement, or effort as a candidate fact attributable to the speaker, even when phrased as praise or encouragement (e.g., 'your hard work is paying off').
Record the target person and the claimed state/outcome as a compact state or relationship memory, linked to the speaker's utterance as evidence.
Do not skip such statements because they are complimentary or because the target is not the speaker.

solves: Messages where one person explicitly assesses another's progress are often skipped as mere praise, so later queries about 'what did X say about Y's progress?' fail. This skill makes extraction preserve such speaker-attributed evaluative statements. Applies to any named third party and progress comments; not to generic aphorisms without a specific subject or internal plans.
